top_signals.title: Gold Slumps 3% to Lowest in Over a Year on Hawkish Fed Signals
top_signals.summary: Gold tumbled over 3% to the lowest in over a year after Federal Reserve officials made the case for more interest-rate hikes to tackle stubborn inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Putin’s delusions of a ‘new Yalta’
top_signals.summary: Russia’s leader cannot be rewarded for aggression with another carve-up of Europe
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Kalshi Turns to Compute Desk in Renewed Push for GPU Futures
top_signals.summary: Kalshi Inc. is working with index provider Compute Desk to launch futures contracts tied to the cost of computing power used for artificial intelligence, pushing into what exchanges see as a potentially lucrative new asset class, according to people familiar with the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
